The '''Vatta Hutta''' was a temple located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Bunku Nagara]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vodran/Legends|Vodran]]. The temple was dedicated to the worship of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] as [[Deity/Legends|deities]]. It was supposedly located on the spot where [[Dojundo]] the Hutt landed on Vodran and where [[Kossak Inijic Ar'durv|Kossak the Hutt]] supposedly became a god.<ref name="LoNH" />
